description: Production lines, machines, and process control. Wear progression, calibration drift, batch variation, energy/mass balance.

characteristic_patterns.name: Wear progression
characteristic_patterns.signature: vibration drift upward over time; rms slowly increasing
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: monotonic rise in vibration RMS over ≥ 1 day

characteristic_patterns.name: Calibration drift
characteristic_patterns.signature: sensor mean drifts vs reference; stationary sensor on stationary process

characteristic_patterns.name: Batch-to-batch variation
characteristic_patterns.signature: regime structure where each batch has its own mean/std
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: n distinct regimes where batches dominate

characteristic_patterns.name: Downtime cycle
characteristic_patterns.signature: production zero/low for fixed window, then recovery

characteristic_patterns.name: Energy/mass balance violation
characteristic_patterns.signature: input − output > tolerance over a sustained window
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: constraint failure on rel_in_out or rel_e_in_out

characteristic_patterns.name: Fatigue accumulation
characteristic_patterns.signature: cycle count × load profile crosses S-N curve threshold

action_library.label: Schedule calibration
action_library.description: When calibration drift is detected at high confidence, queue a calibration window before defects start to flow downstream.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Calibration restores sensor to spec ≈90% of the time.

action_library.label: Trigger preventive maintenance
action_library.description: Schedule a maintenance window when wear progression crosses an early-warning threshold.

action_library.label: Quarantine batch
action_library.description: When a batch shows out-of-spec aggregate, hold it for inspection rather than ship.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Quarantine catches ≈60% of bad batches; cost = inspection time.

action_library.label: Tune process parameters
action_library.description: Adjust setpoint(s) to bring outputs back toward target when drift is gradual.
triggered_when: soft constraint violation but no acute fault
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Online tuning recovers spec ≈55% without downtime.
